Where X-rays Fit

Learning outcome: Explain why X-rays can reveal internal differences and why their use is controlled.

X-rays are one form of electromagnetic energy. Select each point to see how their wavelength and energy make screening possible while requiring careful control. Narration is optional. Enlarge the images to examine their detail, review the summary, then complete this activity’s knowledge check.
